Disabling HTTP Processing For Unrecognized HTTP
Methods

text:
CACHE::enable
Description
Forces the document to be cached. You can also use this command to
cache non-GET requests.
Syntax
CACHE
::
enable
CACHE::enable
Forces the document to be cached.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
uri
]
contains
"images"
}
{
CACHE
::
enable
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
HTTP_REQUEST
,
HTTP_RESPONSE
